data.navTitle: 显微镜台、封闭培养皿与连接管
data.title: The image inside the screen

memoryNodes.cue: Jo looks at the enlarged image.
A microbe appears in a photograph.

data.situation:
A microscope stood on the next bench, connected to a screen. Jo could see a microscopic image without bending over the eyepiece. The attendant pointed to a photographed microbe, then to a sealed Petri dish in the display case. There was also an empty test tube in a stand. A wider tube connected two parts of the demonstration model, and Maya followed it with her finger through the glass. The labels distinguished the observation equipment from the containers. Nothing on this public bench was an invitation to open the sealed samples. Jo: Is the dish the microscope?
Attendant: The microscope makes the image. The dish holds the sample.
Maya: And that narrow glass container?
Attendant: It is a test tube. The larger connecting tube belongs to the model.

readingBlocks.en: A microscope stood on the next bench, connected to a screen. Jo could see a microscopic image without bending over the eyepiece. The attendant pointed to a photographed microbe, then to a sealed Petri dish in the display case. There was also an empty test tube in a stand. A wider tube connected two parts of the demonstration model, and Maya followed it with her finger through the glass. The labels distinguished the observation equipment from the containers. Nothing on this public bench was an invitation to open the sealed samples.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一张台上放着连接屏幕的显微镜。乔不用弯腰看目镜就能看到显微影像。工作人员指向照片中的微生物，又指向展柜里的封闭培养皿。架子里还有一支空试管。一根较宽的管子连接演示模型的两个部分，玛雅隔着玻璃用手指沿管子看。标签区分观察设备和容器。这个公共展台并未邀请人打开封闭样本。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Is the dish the microscope?
Attendant: The microscope makes the image. The dish holds the sample.
Maya: And that narrow glass container?
Attendant: It is a test tube. The larger connecting tube belongs to the model.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：这个皿就是显微镜吗？
工作人员：显微镜产生影像，培养皿装样本。
玛雅：那根窄玻璃容器呢？
工作人员：是试管，较大的连接管属于模型。

glossary.zh: 用来放大观察微小物体的显微镜

externalEvidence.definition: magnifier of the image of small objects

glossary.zh: 与显微镜观察有关的；本例显微的

externalEvidence.definition: of or relating to or used in microscopy

glossary.zh: 微生物，尤其指细菌等微小生物
